skills.title: Grenade
skills.description: Damage to armored units +50%

skills.title: Phantom
skills.description: Goes into phantom status and cannot be actively attacked by land and naval forces, with a cooldown of 2 turns. While in phantom status, mobility +2, lasts for 1 turn(s). Phantom status will be unavailable after attacking.

skills.title: Assassination
skills.description: Cannot be counterattacked. Damage dealt when attacking enemy troops +20% (damage dealt +40% while in phantom status).  Damage dealt is lowered by 50% when attacking buildings.

skills.title: Emergency Bandage
skills.description: Recover 3% maximum HP on the next turn when the troop is more than half damaged.

levels.note:
Unlock Grenade
Unlock Phantom
Unlock Assassination
Unlock Emergency Bandage
